items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The Duke was at the Congress at the time.

ctx.x: years of show business the only time I've ever seen -- I imagine it might have happened at some other time someplace else -- it was the only time I've ever seen a finale stop the show cold. Stop the show. So, this finale stopped the show stone cold to the point that we changed shows out there at that particular time every six weeks. We kept the finale in because the finale stopped the show ... It was on Christopher Columbus and on Fletcher Henderson but at that time there was like principals, what we call…
The Duke was at the Congress at the time.

Yes, he was. Then another principle would come out and "I'd nominate Cab Calloway for king of swing." And another one would come out, I nominate Jimmy Lunceford for king of swing. Now I'm the last one to come on. Chorus girls are on stage already. It's all in tempo to the tune of "Christopher Columbus" which was Fletcher's theme song and was very big at that particular time. Thank you. That's just what it was. So, now they bring me on. The band is steady going, boom, boom (singing tune) so I would come on and I…
